description: This file defines the AbtChromeExtensionProtocol class which manages communication with a Chrome extension, handling messages related to Buganizer attachments, including sending requests and processing responses.

classes.name: AbtChromeExtensionProtocol
classes.description: Manages communication with the Chrome extension for Buganizer attachment handling, including message sending and response processing.

methods.name: setOnBuganizerAttachmentsDownloadStart
methods.description: Sets callback for when attachment download starts.

methods.name: setOnBuganizerAttachmentsDownloaded
methods.description: Sets callback for when attachments have been downloaded.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Initiates the message exchange with the Chrome extension if conditions are met.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages from the extension, processing OpenBuganizerResponse messages.

methods.name: onOpenBuganizerResponseMessageReceived
methods.description: Processes the OpenBuganizerResponse message, fetching attachment blobs and invoking the download callback.

methods.name: isOpenBuganizerResponseMessage
methods.description: Type guard to check if a message is an OpenBuganizerResponse.
